title: Ministry’s Policy on Assisting Singaporeans who Seek NS Deferment
what_it_is: Ministry’s Policy on Assisting Singaporeans who Seek NS Deferment

sections.label: High Performance Sports system support
sections.summary: MCCY recognises sport's power to inspire national pride and, with partners, established the HPS system to support athletes' potential.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: MCCY recognises the power of sport in inspiring the nation and engendering a sense of national pride.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Through Sport Singapore (SportSG) and its partners, including Singapore National Olympic Council, the National Sports Associations (NSAs), the Singapore Sports School, and the National Youth Sports Institute, the High Performance Sports (HPS) system has been established to support our athletes to reach their fullest sporting potential.

sections.label: Male athletes and NS obligations
sections.summary: Under HPS, MCCY works with MINDEF, MHA and NSAs to let male Team Singapore athletes pursue sports and fulfil NS obligations.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: As part of the long-term plan under HPS, we work closely with MINDEF, MHA and the NSAs to enable our male Team Singapore athletes to pursue their sports development and fulfil their NS obligations.

sections.label: NS deferment for sporting talents
sections.summary: MCCY supports NS deferment for talents with potential, commitment to return to NS, citing Joseph Schooling and Quah Zheng Wen.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: MCCY is prepared to support NS deferment applications by sporting talents who have consistently demonstrated the potential to succeed at the highest levels of competition, serve Singapore’s interests, and have provided a definitive commitment to return to serve NS.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: These include swimmers Joseph Schooling and Quah Zheng Wen, who have been granted deferment to train full-time for the Tokyo 2020 Olympics.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Following his Gold-medal achievement in Rio, thus meeting the agreed milestone target that we have with him and the NSA, MINDEF extended his deferment to the Tokyo 2020 Olympics on the recommendation of MCCY.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: My Ministry shares Singaporeans' aspirations for excellence in sports, and does not favour individual sports over team sports.

sections.label: NS deferment for squad athletes
sections.summary: MCCY is prepared to work with MINDEF on NS deferment or training privileges for committed squad athletes to train together.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: If there are sporting talents who are part of this squad, and who demonstrate commitment to represent Singapore and serve NS, MCCY is prepared to work with MINDEF to evaluate NS deferment applications, or training privileges during NS so that the enlisted athletes can train together with the rest of the squad.
